$comment: TRUST1-V3 — the pre-deployment verification gate, as data.
This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what 'main is protected' means. It is read by
scripts/ci/verify-branch-protection.ts, which (a) asserts the required check name still
matches the CI job that produces it, and (b) asserts the live GitHub setting matches this
WHY each setting is here; it does not restate the values. Change them here, nowhere else.
'protection' is verbatim the request body of the GitHub classic branch-protection API:
Nothing in this repository ever sends it. A named human applies it — branch protection on
main is production configuration, and COMMIT_PUSH_DEPLOY_PROTOCOL.md §3 forbids an agent
from changing production configuration. `npm run verify:branch-protection -- --print-apply`
prints the exact command for that human to run.
